title: Map help

replies.author: IviFetita
replies.body:
Download:
1- Create your mediafire account on http://www.mediafire.com/
2- Click on the "upload" button and click upload from computer.

3- And choose the .zip file with the map folder and drag it into the "+"

and now click on "begin upload", wait and click on "copy link".
Paste it in your post or anywhere you need to paste it, and now you have the download link.
Bye :D
